tool: Built-in image_gen; model/version and seed not exposed
scope: Ground texture PNG masters only. Application integration and shipping compression are handled separately.

ground-lava.png.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: square seamless production ground ALBEDO texture. Supplied image is the edit target.
Refine only these problems: Narrow the open red-orange channels and enlarge neutral charcoal crust locally until the total open lava fraction is about25% (current is37%). Break the largest crust rafts into smaller ropy charcoal pieces so no single raft is a landmark. Keep the irregular evenly distributed all-over fissure network and ropy material, not a giant river.
Make ALL lava channels and pools dark muted red-orange/brown, approximately RGB70,30,20; eliminate brighter orange highlights and luminous-looking streaks entirely. The albedo is flat unlit colour; a separate shader supplies emission. Keep crust neutral charcoal without red oxidation so a clean emission mask can be extracted. Preserve quiet painterly texture, gently soft fine detail, uniform illumination, full-bleed square and tileability both directions.
No glow, bloom, flames, smoke, perspective, horizon, sunlight, shadows, sheen, glossy reflection, text, labels, frame or vignette. Request opaque8bit sRGB2048x2048PNG.

initialGeneration.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game ground ALBEDO texture, one square seamless tile, requested 2048 x 2048 pixels, opaque 8-bit sRGB PNG.
Primary request: Active lava ground with many SMALL rafts and plates of thin black-and-charcoal crust, each only 1–3 percent of the tile width, with soft ropy wrinkles in varied directions. Wider interconnecting open lava channels and seams separate the crust plates, with occasional small rounded lava pools. Open lava covers roughly 25 percent of the tile, visibly more than faint cracks in cooled scorched basalt.
Colour separation: crust is neutral dark charcoal (roughly RGB32–55, similar channels), while ALL open lava material is dark muted orange-brown or dull red (roughly RGB80,35,25). The lava material is painted dark, with NO luminous centre. Do not put reddish oxidation on the crust: reddish pigment belongs only to the open channels, seams and pools. This allows an exact separate emission mask to be derived later.
Style: quiet, painterly, natural and restrained, soft fine detail, not photographic, not neon or cartoonish. Full-bleed square. Strictly orthographic straight down, flat UNLIT diffuse albedo. Uniform material colour, no dramatic relief.
Seamless in both directions: left edge matches right edge, top matches bottom. Small random distributed features, no central landmark, no huge plates, no dominant flow direction, gentle overall value variation so repeats remain unobtrusive. Terrain must also look plausible on the side of low hills.
Absolutely no glow, bloom, highlights, shiny reflections, cast shadows, sun, sky, perspective, horizon, vignette, flames, smoke, text, labels, legend, border or watermark. No orange/yellow/white hot light; emission will be supplied by a separate mask. Fill every pixel with ground.

ground-lava-glow.png.method: Deterministic derivation from final albedo; no independent generation

audit.registration: same-pixel scalar extraction from final albedo, followed by centered periodic tent and Gaussian smoothing and 8-pixel edge reconciliation; no spatial offset or independent redraw

processing.softEdge: Periodic3x3tent convolution with weights[1,2,1]×[1,2,1]/16, then Gaussian sigma4px using16px wrapped padding; about1px at shipped512size; duplicated-edgeperiod2047. Reconcile libvips blur-grid rounding with8px opposite-edge smoothstep feather.
processing.output: round(field*255) identically inRGB; no independent image generation or offset
